stem: EBM question: show confidence interval forest-plot about a systematic review (or was it an RCT?) of effectiveness of prophylactic antibiotics for preventing a subsequent UTI in different groups. Mother presents with child who is having her first UTI, and mother wants to know how effective prophylactic antibiotics will be. Read the graph and interpret it (graph shows that group with antibiotics favoured over placebo and confidence interval lying in between -1 and -10%, and the dot at - 6%)

options.text: Prophylactic antibiotics reduce risk of subsequent UTI by 6%
6 children need to be treated with antibiotics to prevent 1 subsequent UTI
